scope: One deterministic synthetic CLS substep comparison; no physical time advance and no Q1R3 convergence claim.
interpretation: Paired CLS conserves total momentum to roundoff and dissipates a small amount of kinetic energy.  Applying the same density change without its momentum flux changes momentum and creates energy in this counterexample.
claim_limit: This establishes that the historical missing pairing can contaminate momentum/energy observables.  It does not quantify the old Q1R3 error or prove that pairing alone restores three-grid convergence.
